decision: Prioritize restoration of the existing RoboTwin setup and its six VLRLA seen/source tasks, starting with scan_object. Hold the unlaunched LIBERO90 search at its recoverable code boundary; preserve its files and zero-spend ledger. No old RoboTwin jobs, learners or budgets resume.
scope: Reuse existing code/assets/common cached Motus policy; prepare the minimal native clean-versus-random baseline and simulator-vs-Flora PPO integration. Confirm actual headroom and scorer discrimination before training. No new model or simulator framework and no mandatory replacement checkpoint search.

Exact retained runtime/common checkpoint, nativePPO compatibility, video-clock and bounded baseline/qualification profile must be concrete before sole-owner dispatch. paper_split: scan_object is one of six seen/source tasks; stamp_seal (the intended task name) is one of six unseen tasks. Training on stamp_seal is possible only as an explicitly disclosed change to that split, not silently part of the six-source pool.
exposure: The preferred restored Motus checkpoint was trained on both clean and randomized data. Clean-versus-random is a condition contrast, not a claim that random was unseen in motor training.
limits: No checkpoint, domain-randomization magnitude, sampler or score tuning to manufacture failures; no source/student/meta-learning admission from restored files or low paper success rates. Preserve all old failed outcomes and recoveries.
common_policy_definition: Identical initializer, normalization and sampler between S and F on the chosen task; no requirement to qualify one motor on all six before a single-task pilot.
